info.title: API.SH: Vivino
info.description: The Vivino API from API.SH: public Vivino data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Wines from Vivino's explorer with every filter: market country and currency, wine type, minimum rating, price range, grapes, regions, origin countries, wine styles and wineries, sorted by rating, number of ratings, price or discount. Each wine has vintage and wine ids, name, year, link, type, winery, region, vintage and wine ratings with counts, the best offer price with merchant link, style with body and acidity, taste structure and flavour notes, and bottle image. 24 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivino-explore

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market country (prices and availability), two letters. Default US.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Price currency, three letters. Default the market's.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: red, white, sparkling, rose, dessert, fortified.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Minimum average rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum bottle price.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum bottle price.

parameters.name: grapes
parameters.description: Comma-separated grape ids (2 = Cabernet Sauvignon, 14 = Pinot Noir, 5 = Chardonnay).

parameters.name: regions
parameters.description: Comma-separated region ids.

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated origin countries (fr, it, es, us ...).

parameters.name: styles
parameters.description: Comma-separated wine style ids.

parameters.name: wineries
parameters.description: Comma-separated winery ids.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: ratings_average (default), ratings_count, price, discount_percent or top_list_rank.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: asc or desc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

wines.name: Château Haut-Brion Pessac-Léognan (Premier Grand Cru Classé) 1989

get.description:
A wine region on Vivino: names, country, description, location, winery and wine counts, parent regions, sub-regions and its main grapes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivino-region

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Region id (394), name (tuscany) or vivino.com/wine-regions/<name> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A wine's user reviews, newest first: rating, review text, language, date, vintage, reviewer alias with rating and follower counts, likes and comments. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivino-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Wine id.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Only reviews of this vintage.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Review language, two letters. Default en.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-50.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Vivino wines by name: for each match the wine, winery, vintage, region, type, rating and ratings count for the vintage and for the wine overall, price where shown for the market, and image. 24 per page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivino-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Wine or winery name, e.g. `opus one`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market country for prices (two letters, default US).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code (three letters).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Wine type: red, white, sparkling, rose, dessert, fortified (comma-separated).

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Lowest rating (1-5).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by ratings_average, ratings_count, price or discount_percent (default best match).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: asc or desc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 24 results a page (default 1). Use `next_page` from the answer.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A wine on Vivino (optionally one vintage): name, winery, region, grapes, average rating and counts, alcohol, closure, style (body, acidity, food pairings), taste structure (acidity, sweetness, tannin, intensity) and flavour notes, highlights, best offer price and merchant, organic and biodynamic flags, image, and every vintage with its rating.

Add `vintage_prices=1` for the market price of every vintage in `vintages` (`price`, `median_price`, `currency`, for the market of `country`; `vintage_prices_market` names it). When a vintage has no offer, its prices are null and `nearest_priced` gives the closest vintage that has one.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivino-wine

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Wine id, the number in vivino.com/.../w/<id>. Or give `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A vivino.com wine link instead of `id`.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: One vintage year. Default the wine's page.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market country for the offer price. Default US.

parameters.name: vintage_prices
parameters.description: Set to `1` to add each vintage's market price to `vintages`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

A winery profile on Vivino: name, region and country, average rating, ratings count, wines count, description, winemaker, website and social links, owning group, address, location, logo, and its top wines with rating and ratings count.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivino-winery

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: url

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every wine a winery makes on Vivino, in the site's rank order: name, link, type, region, style, average rating and count, number of vintages, vintage years, best vintage and bottle image. Filter by wine type.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vivino-winery-wines

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Winery id or name (from vivino.com/wineries/<name>), or the link.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only this wine type.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
